technical_and_design_decisions: Reuse the repository's existing acceptance-test framework, build tooling, conventions, fixtures, and test execution lifecycle rather than introducing a new test framework.
Implement black-box acceptance tests through each module's supported configuration and input/output interfaces, avoiding production-code changes unless required to expose existing functionality.
Use deterministic local test doubles, embedded services, temporary files, or containerized dependencies for external systems such as Splunk, Spark, and shell execution where practical.
Validate both successful processing and key module-specific behavior, including configuration handling, representative data flow, output generation, and failure handling.
Integrate all tests into the existing CI test task and ensure the tests are isolated, repeatable, and safe for parallel or repeated execution.
assumptions: The source repository, module implementations, build scripts, and an existing acceptance-test pattern are available and buildable.
The requested increment consists of adding acceptance-test coverage only; no new production functionality or broad refactoring is required.
Acceptance tests can run with local or mocked dependencies and do not require access to production credentials or external hosted services.
Expected behavior can be derived from existing module documentation, configuration schemas, source code, and neighboring tests.
The existing CI environment supports the required Java version and any already-established test dependencies.
The estimate includes implementation, local execution, debugging, and CI integration, but excludes infrastructure provisioning and major changes to the CI platform.
A single developer performs the work, and estimates represent active work-hours rather than elapsed calendar time.

activities.activity_description: Inspect module implementations, existing acceptance tests, build configuration, CI conventions, test data, and module-specific execution patterns; define coverage scenarios and identify dependency constraints.

Create or extend reusable test utilities, configuration templates, lifecycle management, temporary-resource handling, assertions, representative input data, and cleanup mechanisms shared by the requested modules.
Implement and validate acceptance scenarios for the null sink, including configuration, input delivery, successful consumption, and expected absence or handling of output.
Implement and validate representative rich-gauge input and output behavior, configuration, field or metric handling, and relevant error-path assertions.
Implement tests proving routing decisions for representative records, destination configuration, unmatched-route behavior, and end-to-end delivery to test destinations.
Implement tests for command configuration, argument or input delivery, process execution, captured results, exit-status handling, and safe temporary test resources.
Implement tests using a local stub or test double for Splunk, covering connection/configuration, event submission, representative payloads, and failure or retry behavior supported by the module.
Implement tests for sampling and throughput-related behavior using deterministic input and assertions that avoid timing-sensitive or flaky measurements.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance coverage for spark-app batch job
activities.activity_description: Implement an end-to-end batch-job test with controlled input and output, local or embedded Spark execution as supported, configuration validation, and deterministic result assertions.

activities.activity_name: Acceptance coverage for timestampfile batch job
activities.activity_description: Implement tests for timestampfile job configuration, timestamp-related processing, file creation or update behavior, representative input, and deterministic output verification.

activities.activity_name: CI integration and test execution configuration
activities.activity_description: Register all acceptance tests in the standard CI build, configure required profiles or dependencies, verify clean-environment execution, and ensure failures are reported correctly.

activities.activity_name: Cross-module debugging, stabilization, and regression verification
activities.activity_description: Run the complete suite repeatedly, diagnose compilation and runtime failures, remove environmental flakiness, verify isolation and cleanup, and perform regression checks against existing tests.
Document test prerequisites and execution behavior, review coverage and maintainability, clean up test artifacts, and prepare the completed increment for review.
